title: Pin the shipped route prompt against its contract
action:
Add a test to `control_loop.rs`'s test module that asserts the REAL `skills/bee-herding/references/route-prompt.md` shipped in this repo carries route's contract — the same guard `the_supervisor_prompt_file_shipped_in_this_repo_carries_the_observer_contract` (control_loop.rs:1038-1075) already gives the observer. Open that test and follow its shape exactly; it resolves the file from the repo root and asserts on needles in the body.

Assert the needles that would matter if someone quietly rewrote the document: the pointer to `role-merge.md:73-76` rather than a restated copy of the four conditions; `bee herding interlock`; the `gate_bypass` requirement; the occupancy refusal; the `--lines 200` scrollback dedup; and each item of route's never-list.

Also assert the file resolves through the same `read_prompt_file` path the loop itself uses for `Role::Route`, so a rename of either the role or the file breaks this test rather than breaking a cold 3am tick.

truths: the test reads the real shipped route-prompt.md, not a fixture
it resolves the file through read_prompt_file for Role::Route, so a rename of either breaks the test
it asserts the pointer to role-merge.md:73-76 and fails if the four conditions are restated instead
it asserts both arming checks, the occupancy refusal, and the dedup

trace.dropped_reason: Already delivered inside hrr-1's commit 7275d515. The worker wrote the_route_prompt_file_shipped_in_this_repo_carries_the_router_contract, which reads the REAL shipped skills/bee-herding/references/route-prompt.md through read_prompt_file(&repo_root, Role::Route) — exactly this cell's action, including the resolve-through-the-loop's-own-path requirement. Re-doing it would file a near-duplicate test beside a passing one.
